title: Customers Who Never Order
constraints: Return only the name column aliased as 'Customers'.
A customer who has placed at least one order must not appear in the result.
Write your SQL query in the editor (select JavaScript language).

examples.explanation: Joe and Sam have orders; Henry and Max do not.
Bob placed order 1; Alice has never ordered.

solutionApproaches.title: NOT IN subquery
solutionApproaches.explanation: Collect all customerId values from Orders and exclude them from Customers.

solutionApproaches.title: LEFT JOIN + IS NULL
solutionApproaches.explanation: Join Customers to Orders and keep only the rows where no matching order was found.
